title: Strawberry Icebox Cake with Vanilla Wafers
changes_from_base: A chilled loaf of vanilla wafers layered with vanilla whipped cream and a quick strawberry compote, with strawberry halves round the sides, set in the fridge then firmed briefly in the freezer, instead of sponge and ice cream.
summary: A striking layered icebox cake built from softened vanilla wafers, strawberry compote and vanilla cream, chilled until sliceable.
equipment: medium bowl set over a bowl of iced water

ingredients.item: fresh or frozen hulled strawberries, quartered
fine sea salt or table salt
large strawberries, hulled and halved lengthways

steps.title: Macerate
steps.text: Toss 680 g quartered strawberries with 45 g caster sugar and stand until juice pools, about 15 min, then drain.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer the drained strawberries with 15 ml lemon juice over medium heat, stirring now and then, until soft but still whole and saucy, about 15 min, then chill over an ice bath until cool, about 30 min.

steps.title: Whip
steps.text: Whip 355 ml double cream with 1½ tsp vanilla, 7 g icing sugar and ⅛ tsp salt on medium-high to medium-stiff peaks, about 2-3 min.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Line a 23 x 10 cm loaf tin with cling film, spread 120 ml cream over the base and press in 8 vanilla wafer biscuits, then stand the halved strawberries round the sides with the cut side against the film.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spoon 60 ml compote over the wafers and round the strawberries, top with 120 ml cream and 8 more wafers, then spoon over another 60 ml compote, repeating this layering twice more to make 4 layers in total and finishing with a thin layer of cream.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Press cling film onto the surface and chill until the wafers soften, 6-24 h.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Turn the cake out onto a lined tray, peel off the film and freeze until firm enough to slice, about 1 h, or up to 1 week.

steps.title: Slice
steps.text: Lift onto a board, remove the paper, stand 5 min, then cut 8 slices with a hot knife wiped dry between cuts.

tips: Drain the macerated strawberries well so the compote doesn't turn the layers watery.
Chill the compote fully before layering so it doesn't melt the cream.
Freeze the assembled cake briefly before slicing so the layers hold their shape.
storage: Keep any sliced portions frozen on a lined tray and let them soften for 10 min before serving.
